python3 -c '
import cv2, numpy as np

img = cv2.imread("/work/observations/obs_0087.png")
mask_pot = (img[:,:,2] > 140) & (img[:,:,1] < 100) & (img[:,:,0] < 60)
yp, xp = np.where(mask_pot)
print(f"Pot 1 in obs 87: x=[{xp.min()}, {xp.max()}], y=[{yp.min()}, {yp.max()}], bottom_y={yp.max()}, center_x={xp.mean():.1f}")
width_pot = xp.max() - xp.min() + 1
print(f"Pot 1 width: {width_pot} px")

# In obs 86, pot 1 width was 291 - 233 + 1 = 59 px
# In obs 87, pot 1 width:
w86 = 59.0
w87 = float(width_pot)
d87 = 0.5 / (w87 / w86 - 1)
d86 = d87 + 0.5
print(f"Parallax depth d86 = {d86:.4f} m, d87 = {d87:.4f} m")

# From ground contact in obs 87:
by87 = yp.max()
cx87 = xp.mean()
d_contact = 256.0 * 1.55 / (by87 - 255.5)
Xc87 = (cx87 - 255.5) / 256.0 * d_contact
theta_rad = np.deg2rad(300.0)
X_w = -1.1348 + d_contact * np.sin(theta_rad) + Xc87 * np.cos(theta_rad)
Y_w = 5.0972 + d_contact * np.cos(theta_rad) - Xc87 * np.sin(theta_rad)
print(f"Plant 1 from obs 87 ground contact: X = {X_w:.4f}, Y = {Y_w:.4f}")
'
